title: t3cp/mrs/1
description: data/v1/mrs.json: the fork author's pull requests on upstream T3 Code, read from the public GitHub search API at site build time. Also checked by the build, beyond this schema: counts add up to items plus omitted, each item's state is counted, items are sorted by updated_at descending (then number descending), fetched_at null only on a stale file with no items, and the file is at most 32768 bytes.

fetched_at.description: When the list was read from GitHub (UTC, whole seconds). Kept from the previous file when a build could not read GitHub; null only if no build has read it yet.

stale.description: true when the latest build could not read GitHub and kept the previous list.

source_query.description: The search query the list comes from.

counts.description: Every pull request the query returned, by state, including any left out of items.

omitted.description: How many of the oldest pull requests were left out of items to keep the file within 32 KB.
